description: Open Data Lebanon is an open data portal listed in Open Data Lebanon, an open data portal, published or maintained by Open Data Lebanon (citizen initiative). Open Data Lebanon (opendatalebanon.org) is a citizen initiative that collects public data on Lebanon in one place: 153 resources in English and Arabic, from statistics tables to ministry lists and reports, each with a page of its own and no bulk catalogue interface. Coverage: Lebanon. 14 datasets are listed in the catalogue that this harvest read; 11 of them are about infrastructure and became records of their own. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is set per dataset on the portal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support finding infrastructure and hazard data of this country. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-odl-portal.
licence: set per dataset on the portal
